blocks.html:
Important Information! | Social Distancing | Covid-19

Our crew is still working at keeping busy during this Covid-19 period.
We are practicing social distancing and asking everyone who stops by the garage to respect the rules.
During this period, our installation crew has made good use of the time to install new racks, brush up on training, and do small jobs for clients.
We are able to print floor and window graphics, Warning signs and posters and due to requests, Health and Safety boards. We also offer construction site Covid 19 warning posters all printed on vinyl and can be mounted outdoors. If you would like to learn more about getting your own branded Health and Safety boards, visit HealthSafetyBoard.com
If you would like to know more about Vinyl Wrap Toronto, Click Here.
Like us on Facebook, Follow us on Instagram, Heart us on Twitter and add a Comment on Pinterest.
